## Movement Matrix - By Quarter and Model

```{r movement_matrix_by_quarter, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=12, results='asis'}

# =============================================================================
# Extract movement data from all models
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(ParOut_list)

# Create separate plot for each model
for(model_name in scenarios_name) {
  
  cat("\n\n### ", model_name, "\n\n")
  
  # Extract movement coefficients (returns an array)
  move_array <- diff_coffs_age_period(ParOut_list[[model_name]])
  
  # Convert array to data frame
  move_df <- as.data.frame.table(move_array, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(move_df) <- c("from", "to", "age", "period", "value")
  
  # Convert to numeric
  move_df <- move_df %>%
    mutate(
      from = as.numeric(from),
      to = as.numeric(to),
      age = as.numeric(age),
      period = as.numeric(period),
      value = as.numeric(value)
    )
  
  # Average across all ages for each quarter
  move_summary <- move_df %>%
    group_by(period, from, to) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Quarter = paste0("Quarter ", period))
  
  # Create heatmap
  p <- ggplot(move_summary, aes(x = to, y = from, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ Quarter, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      "Diffusion\nCoefficient", 
      colors = c("royalblue3", "deepskyblue1", "gold", "orange1", "indianred1", "firebrick2", "#AC2020"),
      limits = c(0, NA)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(move_summary$to), labels = paste0("R", unique(move_summary$to))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = unique(move_summary$from), labels = paste0("R", unique(move_summary$from)), trans = "reverse") +
    labs(
      x = "From Region", 
      y = "To Region", 
      title = paste0("Estimated Regional Movement by Quarter (", model_name, ")")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
```

## Stock-Recruitment Relationship

```{r srr_plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}

# =============================================================================
# Extract adult biomass and recruitment data
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(RepOut_list)

# Get adult biomass
adult_biomass_list <- lapply(names(RepOut_list), function(model_name) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[model_name]]
  tmp_ab <- areaSums(adultBiomass(tmp_rep))
  tmp_df <- as.data.frame(tmp_ab, drop = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      year = as.numeric(as.character(year)),
      season = as.numeric(as.character(season)),
      sb = data,
      Model = model_name
    ) %>%
    select(Model, year, season, sb)
  return(tmp_df)
})

adult_biomass <- bind_rows(adult_biomass_list)

# Get recruitment
recruitment_list <- lapply(names(RepOut_list), function(model_name) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[model_name]]
  tmp_rec <- areaSums(popN(tmp_rep)[1,])
  tmp_df <- as.data.frame(tmp_rec, drop = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      year = as.numeric(as.character(year)),
      season = as.numeric(as.character(season)),
      rec = data,
      Model = model_name
    ) %>%
    select(Model, year, season, rec)
  return(tmp_df)
})

recruitment <- bind_rows(recruitment_list)

# Merge adult biomass and recruitment
srr_data_seasonal <- adult_biomass %>%
  left_join(recruitment, by = c("Model", "year", "season"))

# Aggregate to annual (mean SB, sum recruitment)
srr_data <- srr_data_seasonal %>%
  group_by(Model, year) %>%
  summarise(
    sb = mean(sb, na.rm = TRUE),
    rec = sum(rec, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = scenarios_name))

# =============================================================================
# Get Beverton-Holt parameters and create fitted curve
# =============================================================================

bh_list <- lapply(names(RepOut_list), function(model_name) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[model_name]]
  bh_params <- srr(tmp_rep)
  
  # Get max sb for this specific model
  model_data <- srr_data %>% filter(Model == model_name)
  max_sb_model <- max(model_data$sb, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2
  sb_seq <- seq(0, max_sb_model, length = 100)
  
  # Extract parameters as vectors using c()
  a_val <- c(bh_params$a)
  b_val <- c(bh_params$b)
  
  bh_df <- data.frame(
    sb = sb_seq,
    rec = (sb_seq * a_val) / (b_val + sb_seq),
    Model = model_name
  )
  return(bh_df)
})

bh_data <- bind_rows(bh_list) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = scenarios_name))

# =============================================================================
# Define units for scaling
# =============================================================================

sb_units <- 1000
rec_units <- 1000000

# =============================================================================
# Create SRR plot by model with year as color
# =============================================================================

p_srr <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = bh_data, aes(x = sb/sb_units, y = rec/rec_units), color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = srr_data, aes(x = sb/sb_units, y = rec/rec_units, fill = year), shape = 21, color = "black", size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Model, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c("Year", option = "viridis") +
  ylim(c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("Adult biomass (mt; ", format(sb_units, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), "s)"),
    y = paste0("Recruitment (N; ", format(rec_units, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), "s)"),
    title = "Stock-Recruitment Relationship by Model (Annual)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "gray85"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
  )

print(p_srr)


```

## Growth Curve

```{r growth_plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}

# =============================================================================
# Extract growth data from all models
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(RepOut_list)

growth_list <- lapply(seq_along(RepOut_list), function(i) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[i]]
  model_name <- names(RepOut_list)[i]
  
  # Get mean length at age and SD
  tmp_laa <- c(aperm(mean_laa(tmp_rep), c(4, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6)))
  tmp_sd_laa <- c(aperm(sd_laa(tmp_rep), c(4, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6)))
  
  # Calculate confidence intervals (only if single model, otherwise just use mean)
  if(length(RepOut_list) == 1) {
    tmp_lower <- tmp_laa - 1.96 * tmp_sd_laa
    tmp_upper <- tmp_laa + 1.96 * tmp_sd_laa
  } else {
    tmp_lower <- tmp_laa
    tmp_upper <- tmp_laa
  }
  
  growth_df <- data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    age = 1:length(tmp_laa),
    length = tmp_laa,
    lower = tmp_lower,
    upper = tmp_upper
  )
  
  return(growth_df)
})

growth_data <- bind_rows(growth_list) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = scenarios_name))

# =============================================================================
# Define color palette
# =============================================================================

scenario_colors <- get_scenario_colors(scenarios_name)

# =============================================================================
# Create growth plot
# =============================================================================

p_growth <- ggplot(growth_data, aes(x = age, y = length, color = Model, fill = Model)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual("Model", values = scenario_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual("Model", values = scenario_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Age class",
    y = "Length (cm)",
    title = "Model Growth Curve"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "gray85"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_growth)
```

## Composite Catch-at-Length by Fishery

```{r composite_length_fit, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=12, results='asis'}

# =============================================================================
# Prepare length fit data from LengOut_list (composite over time)
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(LengOut_list)

# Extract and aggregate length.fit data for each model from LengOut_list
lfit_data_list <- list()

for(model_name in scenarios_name) {
  
  if(!is.null(LengOut_list[[model_name]])) {
    tryCatch({
      # Extract data from MFCLLenFit object - lenfits slot contains the time series data
      tmp_lfit <- LengOut_list[[model_name]]
      
      # Get the data.frame from lenfits slot
      lfit_df <- tmp_lfit@lenfits
      
      # Aggregate to composite (sum over years/months) - this matches length.fit.preparation() output
      # This creates the "totals" that appear at the bottom of length.fit file
      lfit_composite <- lfit_df %>%
        group_by(fishery, length) %>%
        summarise(
          obs = sum(obs * sample_size, na.rm = TRUE),   # Weight by sample size
          pred = sum(pred * sample_size, na.rm = TRUE), # Weight by sample size
          .groups = "drop"
        )
      
      lfit_data_list[[model_name]] <- lfit_composite
      cat("Successfully loaded length.fit for", model_name, "\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error extracting length.fit for", model_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
    })
  } else {
    cat("Warning: LengOut not available for", model_name, "\n")
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Get fisheries to plot
# =============================================================================

fisheries_to_plot <- fishery_map %>%
  filter(group != "Index") %>%
  pull(fishery) %>%
  unique()

# =============================================================================
# Create separate plot for each model
# =============================================================================

if(length(lfit_data_list) > 0) {
  
  for(model_name in names(lfit_data_list)) {
    
    cat("\n\n### ", model_name, "\n\n")
    
    lfit_model <- lfit_data_list[[model_name]]
    
    # Add fishery names
    pdat_model <- lfit_model %>%
      left_join(fishery_map[, c("fishery", "fishery_name")], by = "fishery") %>%
      filter(fishery %in% fisheries_to_plot)
    
    # Calculate bar width
    if(nrow(pdat_model) > 1) {
      bar_width <- unique(diff(sort(unique(pdat_model$length))))
      if(length(bar_width) == 0 || is.na(bar_width)) bar_width <- 2
    } else {
      bar_width <- 2
    }
    
    # Create plot
    p_model <- ggplot(pdat_model, aes(x = length)) +
      geom_bar(aes(y = obs), fill = "blue", colour = "blue", stat = "identity", width = bar_width, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_line(aes(y = pred), colour = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
      facet_wrap(~ fishery_name, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
      labs(
        x = "Length (cm)",
        y = "Samples",
        title = paste0("Composite Catch-at-Length Fit - ", model_name)
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
      )
    
    print(p_model)
    
  }
  
} else {
  cat("No length.fit data available.\n")
}


```

## Composite Catch-at-Weight by Fishery

```{r composite_weight_fit, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=12, results='asis'}

# =============================================================================
# Prepare weight fit data from WeightOut_list (composite over time)
# =============================================================================

# Check if WeightOut_list exists
if(exists("WeightOut_list")) {
  
  scenarios_name <- names(WeightOut_list)
  
  # Extract and aggregate weight.fit data for each model from WeightOut_list
  wfit_data_list <- list()
  
  for(model_name in scenarios_name) {
    
    if(!is.null(WeightOut_list[[model_name]])) {
      tryCatch({
        # Extract data from MFCLWgtFit object - similar structure to LenFit
        tmp_wfit <- WeightOut_list[[model_name]]
        
        # Get the data.frame from wgtfits slot (similar to lenfits)
        wfit_df <- tmp_wfit@wgtfits
        
        # Aggregate to composite (sum over years/months)
        wfit_composite <- wfit_df %>%
          group_by(fishery, weight) %>%
          summarise(
            obs = sum(obs * sample_size, na.rm = TRUE),   # Weight by sample size
            pred = sum(pred * sample_size, na.rm = TRUE), # Weight by sample size
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        
        wfit_data_list[[model_name]] <- wfit_composite
        cat("Successfully loaded weight.fit for", model_name, "\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error extracting weight.fit for", model_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
      })
    } else {
      cat("Warning: WeightOut not available for", model_name, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # =============================================================================
  # Get fisheries to plot
  # =============================================================================
  
  fisheries_to_plot <- fishery_map %>%
    filter(group != "Index") %>%
    pull(fishery) %>%
    unique()
  
  # =============================================================================
  # Create separate plot for each model
  # =============================================================================
  
  if(length(wfit_data_list) > 0) {
    
    for(model_name in names(wfit_data_list)) {
      
      cat("\n\n### ", model_name, "\n\n")
      
      wfit_model <- wfit_data_list[[model_name]]
      
      # Add fishery names
      pdat_model <- wfit_model %>%
        left_join(fishery_map[, c("fishery", "fishery_name")], by = "fishery") %>%
        filter(fishery %in% fisheries_to_plot)
      
      # Calculate bar width
      if(nrow(pdat_model) > 1) {
        bar_width <- unique(diff(sort(unique(pdat_model$weight))))
        if(length(bar_width) == 0 || is.na(bar_width)) bar_width <- 0.5
      } else {
        bar_width <- 0.5
      }
      
      # Create plot
      p_model <- ggplot(pdat_model, aes(x = weight)) +
        geom_bar(aes(y = obs), fill = "blue", colour = "blue", stat = "identity", width = bar_width, alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_line(aes(y = pred), colour = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
        facet_wrap(~ fishery_name, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
        scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
        labs(
          x = "Weight (kg)",
          y = "Samples",
          title = paste0("Composite Catch-at-Weight Fit - ", model_name)
        ) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
        )
      
      print(p_model)
      
    }
    
  } else {
    cat("No weight.fit data available.\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("WeightOut_list not found. Skipping weight composition plots.\n")
}
```
